definitions.explanation: A reproduction or copy of an original document, text, or artwork. Used in administrative, legal, and everyday contexts for duplicated materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写|うつ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To make a copy of a document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写|うつ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I obtained a copy of the family register at the municipal office.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写|うつ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何通|なんつう}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{残|のこ}って→残る：01187_nokoru⟧おり、⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Several copies of this letter survive and are being analyzed by researchers.

notes:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{写|うつ}す→写す：01227_utsusu⟧ (to copy). Refers to a copy or reproduction of a document, text, or other original. Common in administrative and historical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写|うつ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to make a copy
- ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写|うつ}し: copy of a family register
- ⟦{原本|げんぽん}→原本：15697_genpon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{写|うつ}し: original and copy
- {写|うつ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to keep a copy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧: copy — the modern loanword, more casual and widely used in everyday contexts
- ⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧: reproduction, photocopy — a more formal term, often for mechanical reproduction
- {副本|ふくほん}: duplicate, carbon copy — used in legal and official contexts for official copies of documents
- ⟦{原本|げんぽん}→原本：15697_genpon⟧: original — the opposite of a copy; the source document
